messages.author: 70abc85dd4bcb117
messages.subject: Why does npm pull an outdated version of shiny server everytime?
parts: Insanity is doing the same thing over and over and expecting different results.  I keep trying to install shiny-server using npm and every time it installs version 0.3.0 which does not even run the examples.  I don't know how to change this....help!!!!!!
